_meta.description: Externalized grammar rules for Kestelál. Loaded alongside dictionary.json so the language's morphology (noun classes, case endings, verb paradigms, word order) can be edited as data instead of code. Every {STEM} / {ROOT} placeholder is substituted at runtime by the grammar engine (see kestelalGrammar.* helpers in index.html).

nounClasses._comment: Rules for detecting which class an unmarked noun stem belongs to, checked in order. 'cls' on a dictionary entry always overrides automatic detection.

1st._comment: Consonant-leaning class. Three stem shapes depending on the bare form: ends in -s, ends in a consonant, ends in a vowel. Each shape has its own suffix set below. {R}=lowercased stem, {STRIPPED}=stem with final accent removed, {SROOT}=stem with trailing -s removed, {FINALCONS}=final consonant repeated for gemination (empty if stem already ends in a doubled consonant).

2nd._comment: Vocalic-stem class. {BASE}=stem with trailing -s stripped (if present), {STEMV}=the vowel immediately before a trailing -s, or the final letter otherwise.

adjectives._comment: Adjectives co-inflect with the noun they modify, using the SAME case-ending logic as 1st-class nouns. {GEM} is the gemination consonant (see nounClasses.1st.shapes.endsInConsonant.FINALCONS).

properNouns._comment: Inflection for proper names not found in the dictionary (pass-through handling). Plural forms only apply when explicitly marked plural by a quantifier or recognized English plural pattern (see properNounPluralPatterns below) — singular names ending in -s (e.g. 'Jonas') must NOT be treated as plural.

verbs._comment: Verb suffix paradigm. mode=direct|reflexive, time=past|present|future, aspect=simple|continuous|perfect. Each cell lists the canonical suffix first, then any recognized shorthand alternatives (used only for RECOGNITION on the Kestelál→English side, never generated).

prepositions._comment: Which grammatical case each preposition/conjunction-as-preposition governs on the noun that follows it. Falls back to 'accusative' if a preposition's dictionary entry has no explicit _governsCase field and isn't listed here.

quantifiers._comment: English quantifier words that, when matched to a dictionary ADJ entry, behave as quantifier-adjectives: they co-inflect with the following noun's case/number rather than taking their own independent case.

articles._comment: Which token types take an English definite article when rendering Kestelál→English. Proper names never take an article.

wordOrder._comment: Kestelál clause order when generating from English. Each slot is emitted in this sequence; empty slots are skipped.
wordOrder._note_prepositions: Prepositions themselves are never emitted as separate words — their meaning is carried entirely by the case ending on the governed noun.

irregularEnglishPastTense._comment: English irregular past-tense forms mapped to their infinitive, used when recognizing English verbs during English→Kestelál translation (e.g. 'spoke' -> 'speak' -> subadár).
